svg.title: Both turbine expansions on the h–s (Mollier) diagram
svg.text: Both turbine expansions on the h–s (Mollier) diagram
h–s diagram for water (as attached to the paper), redrawn from IAPWS-97
State 1 = 25 MPa isobar × 550 °C isotherm. 2 Isentropic HP expansion: straight down to 4 MPa → 2s (2860).
Actual HP exit 2 = 4 MPa × 300 °C (2962); the dashed 1 → 2 line slopes right because s rises.
Reheat along the 4 MPa isobar to 550 °C → state 3 (3560).
Isentropic LP expansion: straight down to the 10 kPa isobar → 4s (x ≈ 0.88, 2293).
Actual LP exit 4 = 10 kPa × x = 0.93 (2416). Violet bars: isentropic vs actual work of each turbine.
Redrawn from the IAPWS-97 steam properties; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
